messages:
Maria: Quick weekly health check for Galeon — p95/p99 by route & model, streaming vs non-stream, plus usage/spend. TL;DR: streaming p95 improved; non-stream p99 tail on /chat/sync spiked; spend +12% month-over-month.

Ajay: Can you drop the numbers? Need to call out the worst routes so Eng can triage.

Sam: short numbers from telemetry (last 7d):
```
/ chat /stream  (rw-v3-base)   p95=85ms   p99=270ms   errors=0.2%
/ chat /sync    (rw-v2-large)  p95=140ms  p99=900ms   errors=0.8%
/ generate-non  (rw-v2-small)  p95=120ms  p99=420ms   errors=0.9%
```
Note: streaming shows steady p95; p99 tail mostly on /chat/sync during batch-import windows.

Tina: We saw the customer run 3 heavy import jobs Tue/Wed night — they matched the p99 spikes. import jobs are bursty and hit non-stream endpoints.

Maria: That explains a lot. Usage MTD: $9.8k (≈ +12% vs last month). Requests/day up 18%. Those import jobs are inflating both tokens and tail latency.

Ajay: Any correlated infra signals? GPU queue length or eviction rates?

Sam: GPU queue rises during the import windows, and autoscaler didn't spin extra dedicated nodes quickly enough. Also observed higher mem pressure on rw-v2-large which increases kv cache misses — likely causing the p99 blowouts.

Maria: Error rate summary: global 0.4% but /generate-non and /chat/sync sit ~0.8-0.9%. Most are 503s/timeouts during heavy prefixes.

OpsBot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy of caching tweak tagged "galeon-cache-2026-03" completed at 3167778920. Monitoring for 30m.

Ajay: Good — caching tweak should help prefix-heavy imports. If p99 still high we should temporarily route import traffic to Dedicated pool (they have reserved capacity placeholder). Can we do that as a safety valve?

Sam: We can. Suggestion: enable route-level fallback to dedicated for requests > 200k tokens or from import user-id range. Quick config change + short rollout.

Maria: Action items:
- Sam: validate fallback rule + simulate import (ETA 24h)
- Ajay: prepare canary traffic split (10% -> dedicated) and rollback plan (ETA today EOD)
- CS (Maria): notify customer and ask to throttle imports until we confirm fix; record that in account notes

Tina: If we can't guarantee <500ms p99 on non-stream in next week, renewal conversation could surface. They're happy otherwise but want predictable latency for batch imports.

Maria: Noted — renewal risk = medium if p99 persists. I'll schedule an enablement session on streaming best-practices and configuring imports to use chunked streaming. Proposed: Wed 11am PT demo + runbook. Tina, can you invite their SRE?

Tina: Yup, I'll invite them. Also capturing feedback: they asked for clearer docs on recommended batch sizes and an example config for fallback routing.

Ajay: I'll add a short doc + sample policy to the repo and link it in the enablement invite.

Sam: Monitoring follow-ups: I'll push a dashboard with split p95/p99 by route+model and a traffic-tag filter for import jobs (ETA tomorrow morning).

Maria: Great. I'll update the account health sheet: status=watch, actions assigned, spend flagged. Follow-up sync Friday 10am PT.

Tina: Thanks team — appreciate the fast turnaround. :thumbsup:

OpsBot: incident-tracker: New ticket created GALEON-1123 (latency-tail during batch imports) assigned to @Sam and @Ajay.
